title: 第5章 遗留之物第6章 危机
slug: 巫师开局获得传承之一
lines: 学院的浮空船看起来并没有很大，艇长几百米，高度只有两、三层楼高。
浮空船的最前端放着一个霜龙的头颅，船身线条流畅，表面的魔法金属散发着冷冽的光泽。
进入浮空船，才发现浮空船内部别有洞天，里面十分宽敞，空间足以容纳千人，一个巨大的阶梯从大厅的一边延伸至二楼。
大厅内部已经有数十人，除了披着巫师袍的人还有几个穿着皮甲或板甲的身影，应该是来自遗弃之地的人。
他们来这的路上可不太平，不仅是路上的魔兽，有些变态的巫师甚至会举行血猩的游戏，让他们为了生存不得不自相残杀。
学徒们站在大厅各处，已经隐隐形成了各自的小团体，见到又有一人进来，无数的目光聚焦在修斯身上，有好奇、有不屑，
被这么多目光打量并没有影响修斯，他淡淡扫了一眼，便挑了一个没人的地方做下。
没过多久，一个身影来到修斯面前，来者是来自中城区布里特家的瓦莱丽·布里特。
她与修斯还算熟悉，也是同班同学，少女有一头干练的短发，紫色的眼眸清澈而锐利。
“好久不见，修斯”
“好久不见”
修斯回应道。
…经过短暂的回忆瓦莱丽发现似乎并没有什么话题可以跟眼前的少年寒暄，便直奔主题。
“莱斯准备组建一个团队，以后可以互帮互助，你要不要加入。
他的家族有一位永霜尖塔的正式巫师，他承诺将来会给我们机会找那位正式巫师购买晋升正式巫师的资源。”
提到正式巫师，少女的脸上露出了些许向往的神色。
“抱歉，我目前没有加入的打算，我打算投奔我姐”
修斯装出思考的样子，然后缓缓回应道。
“好吧，祝你好运”
听到被拒绝，瓦莱丽并没有多意外。
然后转身走向团队。
修斯并没有和人结盟的打算，毕竟加入这种小团体意味着会有很多制约，那些人什么样也不清楚。
而且巫师的世界可没有那么多团结而言，要知道，哪怕是在高等巫师学院，晋升正式巫师的资源也十分稀少。
他可不认为那个正式巫师私下有那么多晋升正式巫师的资源。
又过了一段时间，一个令修斯感到意外的人登上了船，来者正是泰尔的弟弟莫尔，泰尔的火元素亲和，加上半精灵的身份，八成去的是自然语者学院。
自然语者学院几乎九成的巫师和巫师学徒是主修自然元素的巫师，而且只招收精灵或者半精灵，他还以为两兄弟都会去那。
“又见面了，修斯”
修斯点头示意，并未过多询问，莫尔走到一旁去和其他相识的人寒暄，瓦莱丽注意到了莫尔，便缓缓走向他，似乎也准备拉他入伙。
修斯没再关注。
content_en:
The academy's floating boat doesn't look very big, with a length of several hundred meters and a height of only two or three stories.
The head of a frost dragon is placed at the front end of the floating ship. The hull has smooth lines, and the magic metal on the surface exudes a cold luster.
After entering the floating ship, I discovered that there is a unique cave inside the floating ship. It is very spacious and has enough space to accommodate a thousand people. A huge staircase extends from one side of the hall to the second floor.
There are already dozens of people inside the hall. In addition to the people wearing wizard robes, there are also several figures wearing leather armor or plate armor. They should be people from the abandoned land.
Their journey here was not peaceful. Not only were there monsters on the road, but some perverted wizards would even hold blood ape games, forcing them to kill each other in order to survive.
The apprentices were standing all over the hall, already forming their own small groups. When they saw another person coming in, countless eyes focused on Hughes, some curious and some disdainful.
Being looked at by so many eyes did not affect Hughes. He took a quick glance and picked a place where no one was around to do it.
Not long after, a figure came to Hughes. The person who came was Valerie Britt from the Britt family in Midtown.
She and Xius were relatively familiar with each other and were classmates in the same class. The girl had short, sleek hair and clear and sharp purple eyes.
"Long time no see, Hughes"
“Long time no see”
Hughes responded.
...After a brief recollection, Valerie found that there seemed to be no topic to chat with the young man in front of her, so she went straight to the topic.
“Les is going to form a team so that we can help each other in the future, do you want to join?
His family has an official wizard from Everfrost Spire, and he promised to give us the opportunity to find that official wizard in the future to purchase the resources to be promoted to an official wizard. "
When the official wizard was mentioned, the girl's face showed a look of yearning.
"Sorry, I have no plans to join at the moment. I plan to join my sister."
Hughes pretended to think, and then responded slowly.
"Well, good luck"
Valerie wasn't too surprised when she heard the rejection.
Then he turned and walked towards the team.
Hughes has no intention of forming an alliance with others. After all, joining such a small group means there will be many restrictions, and those people don't know what they are like.
Moreover, the world of wizards does not have that much unity. You must know that even in the Higher Wizarding College, the resources for promotion to official wizards are very scarce.
He didn't think that the official wizard had so many resources to be promoted to a formal wizard privately.
Some time later, a person who surprised Hughes boarded the ship. The person who came was none other than Tyr's younger brother Maul. Tyr's affinity with the fire element and his identity as a half-elf meant that he most likely went to the Natural Speaker Academy.
Almost 90% of the wizards and wizard apprentices at Natural Speaker Academy are wizards majoring in natural elements, and they only recruit elves or half-elves. He thought both brothers would go there.
"See you again, Hughes"
Hughes nodded and didn't ask too much. More walked aside to chat with other acquaintances. Valerie noticed More and walked towards him slowly, seeming to be ready to recruit him.
Hughes stopped paying attention.
